title: Acyclic digraphs have a source
statement: Let $D$ be a digraph on a finite, nonempty vertex set that contains no directed cycle. Then $D$ has a vertex $v$ whose indegree vanishes, $d^{-}(v) = 0$; that is, no arc of $D$ has $v$ as its head.
replaced:
\emph{Let \texttt{D} be a digraph with no
directed cycle.  (a) Show that \texttt{$\delta$$^{-}$ = 0}.}
